fields.subtitle: Eastside High School shelter
fields.whatHappened: Two residents argued over a charging outlet near the quiet area. Voices were raised for several minutes. No one was hurt.
response: Shelter manager separated the two residents and offered a quiet space.
Mental health lead offered each resident a conversation.
A second charging station was set up.
fields.followUp: Manager to check in with both residents in the morning. Report to the EOC with the daily count.
